name: SMRITI Landed Cost Allocation

fields.label: Company
fields.description: All linked Purchase Receipts (and their Purchase Invoices, if any) must belong to this Company. Also drives the read-only valuation_basis default below.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Currency of the linked Purchase Receipts. Must be identical across all receipts.

fields.label: Purchase Receipts
fields.description: One or more Purchase Receipts this allocation covers. Validation (controller): all must be Submitted (docstatus=1), same Company, same Currency.

fields.label: Shipment Reference
fields.description: Optional free-text grouping reference, e.g. container/shipment number.

fields.label: Default Allocation Method
fields.description: Phase 1 active values only. Weight/Volume are reserved (Phase 2) -- must NOT appear in this Select's options.

fields.label: Valuation Basis
fields.description: Phase 1: 'Purchase Only' is the sole active value. 'Landed Inclusive' is reserved (Phase 2), not selectable. This field is read-only here -- it reflects the Company-level setting and must never be edited mid-stream on existing transactions (immutability principle).

fields.label: Base Purchase Value
fields.description: = Sum(Purchase Receipt item rate x qty) across all selected receipts.

fields.label: Landed Cost %
fields.description: = (additional_cost / base_purchase_value) x 100. GUARD: if base_purchase_value <= 0, set to 0 instead of raising a divide-by-zero error.

fields.label: Cost Per Unit
fields.description: = estimated_landed_cost / total qty across selected receipts.

fields.label: Audit Snapshot
fields.description: Populated ONCE by the on_submit controller hook. Never editable in the UI, never recomputed after submit -- including on Cancel. See validation spec for population logic.

_spec_reference: SMRITI_Landed_Cost_Spec_v1.md Section 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, Revision D. amend=0 deliberately: per Section 1.3, corrections supersede via a new dated record rather than amending an existing one, to preserve clean audit lineage.
